title: Evidence on Motions and Applications
status: Phase 1 Complete based on uploaded materials: 39:1, 39.01, 39.02, 39.03, 39.04 and case law. Requires TOC verification that no 39.05+ exists.
coreDoctrine: Rule 37 tells the system how a motion is brought. Rule 39 tells the system how facts are proven on motions and applications.
authoritySectionsCaptured: 39.03 Evidence by Examination of a Witness

deadlines.name: MovingPartyAffidavitDeadline
deadlines.deadline: At least 7 days before hearing, served with notice and filed with proof of service.

deadlines.name: RespondingReplyAffidavitDeadline
deadlines.deadline: At least 4 days before hearing, served and filed with proof of service.

decisionTrees.name: MotionEvidenceReadiness
logic: Default evidence form is affidavit unless statute/rule says otherwise.
Check moving affidavit 7-day deadline.
Check responding/reply affidavit 4-day deadline.
Classify evidence type: personal knowledge, information and belief, expert, lawyer evidence, discovery evidence, witness transcript.
Run admissibility and weight review.
Link evidence to Rule 37 relief and grounds.

decisionTrees.name: InformationAndBeliefValidity
logic: If statement is information and belief, require source identification and belief statement.
If source is vague, flag defect.
If contentious fact on application, flag risk.
If lawyer evidence routed through staff affidavit on contentious fact, flag counsel evidence risk.

decisionTrees.name: WithoutNoticeDisclosure
logic: If motion/application is without notice, require full and fair disclosure of all material facts.
Check contrary evidence, opponent position, and key documents.
If material omission exists, set aside risk is high.

decisionTrees.name: CrossExaminationSequencing
logic: Before cross-examination, confirm party served every affidavit intended to be relied on.
Confirm Rule 39.03 examinations completed if any.
After cross-examination, block later affidavits or Rule 39.03 exams unless leave/consent.
If new matter raised, assess leave for subsequent affidavit.

decisionTrees.name: DiscoveryEvidenceOnMotion
logic: Adverse party discovery may be used on motion subject to admissibility and Rule 31.11 modifications.
Own discovery cannot be used without consent.
Link discovery admission to motion issue, relief, and proof requirement.

crossRuleDependencies.relationship: Rule 37 controls motion procedure; Rule 39 controls motion evidence.
Rule 39.04 imports adverse discovery evidence into motions.
Documents and privilege feed affidavit exhibits and motion evidence.
Summary judgment uses motion evidence but has special evidence logic.
Expert opinion evidence requirements interact with Rule 39.01 expert evidence.

uiImplications: Ask what evidence supports each requested order.
Flag information-and-belief statements and require named sources.
Warn where lawyer/law clerk affidavit is used for contentious facts.
Require full-and-fair disclosure checklist for without-notice motions.
Track cross-examination sequencing and late affidavit risks.
Allow discovery admissions to be used as motion evidence only through Rule 39.04 logic.
codingImplementationNotes: Do not code Rule 39 as document upload only.
Rule 39 must sit between MotionEngine and EvidenceEngine.
MotionEvidenceRecord attaches to MotionRecord and MasterCaseSchema evidence/proof objects.
ExParteDisclosureAssessment must be mandatory for without-notice workflows.
DiscoveryToMotionBridge must reuse Rule31 DiscoveryAdmissionRecord and Rule30 EvidenceDocument objects.
EvidenceWeightEngine should support High/Medium/Low confidence and explain why.
